home.heroWelcome: Welcome to the official website of the
home.heroBrand: Embassy of the DRC in the Republic of Korea
home.heroSubtitle: A diplomatic mission serving citizens, cooperation and partnership between the DRC and the Republic of Korea.

visas.title: Visas
visas.desc: Guidance and pre-application for travel to the DRC.

home.mission1Text: Represent the DRC before the authorities of the Republic of Korea and promote national interests.
home.mission2Text: Support Congolese residents and visitors with essential formalities.
home.mission3Text: Foster political, economic, cultural and academic exchanges between both countries.
home.ambassadorBody: The Embassy works daily to strengthen dialogue between Kinshasa and Seoul, serve our compatriots and consolidate a partnership based on mutual respect and shared development.
home.aboutBody: Based in Seoul, the Embassy is the permanent representation of the Democratic Republic of the Congo in the Republic of Korea. It conducts diplomatic action, provides consular services and supports bilateral cooperation.
home.aboutCheck1: Protection and guidance for Congolese nationals
home.aboutCheck3: Promotion of economic and cultural relations
home.history1963: Establishment of diplomatic relations with the Republic of Korea.
home.history1990: Opening of the DRC Embassy in Seoul.
home.history2023: Presentation of credentials by H.E. Atoki Ileka.
home.news1: Strengthening DRC Republic of Korea relations
home.news1Excerpt: Diplomatic dialogue and bilateral cooperation prospects.
home.news3Excerpt: Promoting Congolese culture with the public and diaspora.

embassy.title: The Embassy
embassy.subtitle: Diplomatic mission of the Democratic Republic of the Congo in the Republic of Korea.
embassy.welcomeBody: The Embassy represents the DRC before the Government of the Republic of Korea. It protects Congolese interests, provides consular services and strengthens bilateral partnership.
embassy.historyBody: Diplomatic relations between the DRC and the Republic of Korea date back to 1963. The Embassy in Seoul was established in July 1990 under the DRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
embassy.ambassadorBody: H.E. Atoki Ileka, Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary, presented credentials in May 2023.
embassy.missionBody: Diplomatic action, consular services, economic promotion, cultural and academic cooperation, official information.
embassy.sourceNote: Information published in the diplomatic list of the Republic of Korea and official Seoul directories.

services.title: Consular services
services.intro: Passport, registration, civil status, visas and assistance guidance published for users of the Embassy in Seoul.
services.accountRequired: Some procedures require a user account or an in-person deposit.

civilStatus.title: Civil status and legalisations
civilStatus.intro: Certificates and legalisations issued by the DRC Embassy in Seoul to nationals under its jurisdiction. Online request (email and password), then file the supporting documents.
civilStatus.laissezBody: Issued only to Congolese nationals whose passport has expired or been stolen and who wish to travel to the DRC. Valid for a single journey.
civilStatus.catalogIntro: List published by the Embassy. Detailed supporting documents outside laissez-passer are indicative (other DRC missions) confirm at the counter.
civilStatus.formHint: Labels aligned with DRC attestation forms (Nom, Post-nom, Prénom, purpose…) and the Seoul procedure (email + password).
civilStatus.motifPh: State the intended use of the document and any useful details…
civilStatus.adresseCoree: Address in the Republic of Korea
civilStatus.success: Your request has been recorded. Then appear at the consular service with the original documents.
civilStatus.source: List source: DRC Embassy Seoul (legalisation / other). Supporting docs cross-checked with other DRC missions Seoul fees to confirm.

consularReg.title: Consular card / registration
consularReg.intro: Registration on the register of Congolese nationals established in the Republic of Korea at the Embassy in Seoul. Strongly recommended for any stay longer than six months.
consularReg.whoHint: Any Congolese national establishing themselves in Korea.
consularReg.formHint: Fields aligned with DRC consular forms (Nom, Post-nom, Prénom…) and the Seoul published procedure (email + password account).
consularReg.sectionAddressKr: Address in the Republic of Korea
consularReg.typeSejourPh: E.g. residence card, D-2, D-4 visa, work permit…
consularReg.success: Your consular registration request has been recorded. The service will contact you during Embassy hours.
consularReg.sourceSeoul: Sources: DRC Embassy Seoul (consular card); DRC consular form labels (Nom, Post-nom, Prénom, parents, address).

passport.title: Biometric passport
passport.intro: Passport applications for Congolese nationals living in or visiting the Republic of Korea. All applications are filed in person at the Embassy in Seoul.
passport.docsIntro: List published by the Seoul consular service. Bring originals and copies as instructed at the counter.
passport.nationalIntro: Since 2025, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs publishes a new ICAO-compliant biometric passport with online pre-registration. Diaspora modalities may differ from the Seoul local fee confirm with the consular service.
passport.lossBody: Report the loss immediately to local police, keep the report, then contact the Embassy. A laissez-passer may be considered for a single return trip to the DRC.
passport.preAppHint: Sign in to start a passport pre-application in your user area.
passport.sourceSeoul: Source: information published by the DRC Embassy in the Republic of Korea (passport service).
passport.sourceNational: Sources: DRC MFA (press release / passport FAQ), passeport.gouv.cd and e-NIF portals. Confirm for files handled in Seoul.

visas.title: Visas
visas.intro: Guidance based on information published for applicants at the Embassy in Seoul. Visa decisions belong exclusively to the competent authorities.
visas.tariffsIntro: Amounts and processing times indicated by the Seoul consular service (KRW).
visas.source: Source: information published by the DRC Embassy in the Republic of Korea. Please confirm with the consular section.
visas.evisaBody: Apply online on the official portal evisa.gouv.cd. File fees are paid on submission; the visa fee is paid after acceptance.
visas.preAppHint: You can prepare an online pre-application via your user area (account required).

news.title: News
news.intro: Releases and updates on DRC Republic of Korea cooperation, economic partnerships and opportunities (scholarships, investment).
news.sources: Public sources: International Cooperation ministry; ANAPI KOTRA; KOICA CIAT and GKS programmes; diplomatic statements.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Answers to common requests. For specific cases, use the contact form.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Send your request to the relevant service. An acknowledgement will be issued after registration.
contact.formHint: Required fields must be completed. Describe your request clearly.
contact.name: Full name
contact.subject: Subject
contact.messagePlaceholder: State the purpose, documents you already hold, and your availability…
contact.success: Your message has been recorded. The competent service will reply as soon as possible.

assistance.title: Consular assistance
assistance.intro: Protection and guidance for Congolese nationals in the Republic of Korea. In a life-threatening emergency, call local services first, then the Embassy.
assistance.emergencyLead: Priority to Korean emergency services, then notify the Embassy for consular follow-up.
assistance.emergencyNote: Clearly state the national's name, location, nature of the situation and a callback number.
assistance.typesIntro: The Embassy may be contacted in the following cases. Arrangements depend on local authorities and the file.
assistance.registerBody: If you stay more than six months in Korea, register with the Embassy. This helps with formalities and emergency contact.
assistance.guideBody: Practical information for newcomers: formalities, health, associations and useful contacts.

invest.title: Invest in the DRC
invest.intro: Institutional guidance for partners and investors interested in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Project approval falls under ANAPI and the competent authorities.
invest.sectorsIntro: Sectors highlighted by ANAPI and the national diversification strategy (beyond exclusive reliance on mining).
invest.incentivesIntro: Indicative summary of the Investment Code and benefits published by ANAPI.
invest.incentivesNote: Exact conditions, durations and equipment lists are confirmed when ANAPI processes the file.
invest.sources: Sources: ANAPI (anapi.cd); Investment Code; Primature / AIM Congress 2025; ANAPI KOTRA MoU (June 2024).

footer.provisional: Some notices remain to be validated by the Embassy.
footer.tagline: Diplomacy, consular services and DRC Korea partnership.
footer.sources: Sources: diplomatic list of the Republic of Korea; official Seoul directories.
